title: Basa - Tandoori Spicy Fish
preamble:
Ingredients:-
Tandoori curry paste
1/2
teaspoon ground cumin
1/2
teaspoon ground coriander
2
teaspoons ground garam masala
2
teaspoons sweet Paprika
1/2
teaspoon hot Chilli powder - or 1/2 teaspoon gochaguru powder
Juice
of half a Lemon
1
or 2 tablespoons olive oil as needed
1
teaspoon Salt
½
teaspoon Turmeric
1
tablespoon Tomato puree
1
teaspoon garlic in a jar
1
teaspoon ginger in a jar
For the fish
1
or 2 tablespoons yoghurt as needed

1
or 2 tablespoons yoghurt as needed

Method:-
Make the tandoori paste
In a large bowl add yoghurt and half of the paste, mix well and coat the basa fillets. Set aside.
Heat the oven to Gas Mark 5
Wrap the fish, complete with marinade, loosely in foil and bake for about 20 minutes - check it is cooked before serving
